mapper.select:
select a.* from (select * from tbl_fwgl_leader_xf where LEADERTYPE =1
and CENTRALGROUPTOPIC like concat(concat('%',#{param.topic}),'%')
and CENTRALGROUPTIME > #{param.startTime} and CENTRALGROUPTIME < date_add(#{param.endTime},identity ,1)
union all select * from tbl_fwgl_leader_xf where LEADERTYPE =2
and DISCUSSTOPIC like concat(concat('%',#{param.topic}),'%')
and DISCUSSTIME > #{param.startTime} and DISCUSSTIME < date_add(#{param.endTime},identity ,1)
union all select * from tbl_fwgl_leader_xf where LEADERTYPE =3
and PROPAGANDATOPIC like concat(concat('%',#{param.topic}),'%')
and PROPAGANDATIME > #{param.startTime} and PROPAGANDATIME < date_add(#{param.endTime},identity ,1)
union all select * from tbl_fwgl_leader_xf where LEADERTYPE=4
and OTHERTOPIC like concat(concat('%',#{param.topic}),'%')
and OTHERTIME > #{param.startTime} and OTHERTIME < date_add(#{param.endTime},identity ,1) ) a where 1=1
and BELONGGROUP in
#{item}
and CREATOR = #{param.creator}
and WORKUNIT = #{param.workUnit}
order by id desc
